metadata.name: Life Love Light by 1 3/33
metadata.description: Life Love Light is the first song we ever created. It was inspired by a life-changing experience on Catalina Island on 4/19/21. My girlfriend and I saw a beautiful ball of light in the sky while sitting next to a 30ft cross at night. We are here to spread Love & Light through music.

metadata.name: SHUT IT OFF by TAY 21/50
metadata.description: This song is about putting my inner mechanics on full display. There’s things I don’t like about myself, how I come across so guarded, bottle up my emotions, second guess my every move, question my own confidence, it’s the darker parts of what lies inside. I think everyone has parts of themselves they wish could change. This project is turning a mirror inward, and about accepting everything about yourself, all your flaws, and using it as fuel to express yourself to the fullest. I want others to feel comfortable in their own skin and be themselves. I aim to inspire & empower the voices of other creators. Every tokenholder will receive 1% of streaming royalties PLUS your name appearing in the SHUT IT OFF music video, and access to a private Discord channel within my server, which will be a place for creative conversation & first listens to my new music. All funds raised will go directly towards marketing & music video costs for my new single “SHUT IT OFF.” This allows YOU to be a part of the release directly - profit sharing alongside with me and spreading the message behind my music. I am an independent artist, meaning instead of a record label, I am giving listeners the power to support my journey.
